title: Two source systems that both number their companies from C1
intent: Company id C1 in one export and company id C1 in another are two different companies, and each system's contacts reference their own. The two companies stay separate, and each relationship points at the company from its own export. A package check that resolved a relationship's far end by raw id alone, without the record mapping it belongs to, made one company overwrite the other and then reported the correct relationship as pointing at the wrong record. The two companies are reported as a duplicate candidate — the engine says it noticed the shared id and did not act on it — and the contacts, numbered A-1 and B-1, collide with nothing.
